scope: Bounded codec-32 PCM16 mono/stereo reconstruction; rw_data.dll is outside frozen client/LS3DF function ledger. No complete-function credit.

instruction_anchors.meaning: Codec byte 20 selects magnitude table row six
Compare RIFF/fmt/data identifiers and copy canonical 44-byte header when matched
Read block alignment/channel count and select PCM16 mono/stereo branches
Stereo signed-magnitude deltas use row-six table and independent wrapping 16-bit histories
Mono copies two-byte seed before decoding deltas
Mono delta sign/magnitude lookup and wrapping 16-bit sample stores
Archive reader dispatches sound codes and restores first-block 44-byte header state

limitations: Only codec byte 32, canonical PCM WAV header, 16-bit mono/stereo and independently seeded continuation blocks. Other quality codes, widths, metadata layouts and original reader/error ABI remain unsupported.
Host bounds checks reject truncated/overlong/alignment/size mismatches; original routine did not perform those checks.
No sound checksum verification or patch overlay precedence reconstruction.
audit: Rebuilt button.wav equals original decoder output byte-for-byte: 5638 bytes, SHA-256 ced364c301e041d9b7e8c3e78672cb2b967b79c9f2542888fb8c7bf38416500a. Eighteen differential vectors (78224 bytes) cover all signed magnitude bytes, mono/stereo, first/continuation, extrema/wrapping and maximum blocks. Native i386 routine audit used temporary ELF/GDB, stopped before OS calls; no DLL startup, game or Proton launched. Temporary copied code/vectors removed after audit.
